title: "clade_v_pango_plot"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(emmeans)
```


#read in clade and PANGO lineage counts accessed June 5th  
```{r}
cladenum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global-2.tsv") %>% mutate(variant = "clade") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/pango_lineages/global.tsv.gz

pangonum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(variant = "pango") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/nextstrain_clades/global.tsv.gz


#load in metadata from nextstrain 
metadata <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/metadata.tsv") 

#https://ncov-clades-schema.vercel.app
```
#List of pango lineages + clades to plot 
```{r}
#making list of the PANGO lineages and their corresponding clades 

#group by the clade membership column and find the most common pango lineages within each clade based on nextstrain data 
metadata_clade_pango <- metadata %>%
  group_by(clade_membership) %>%
  count(pango_lineage) 

#strip anything past the third letter from the metadata clade_membership
metadata_clade_pango <- metadata_clade_pango %>% 
  mutate(clade_membership = str_extract(clade_membership, "^[0-9]+[A-Z]"))


#old clade/ pango pairings
 names <- tibble(
   clade = c("21K", "21L", "22B", "23A", "24E", "24A", "25C"),
  pango = c("BA.1", "BA.2", "BA.5", "XBB.1.5", "KP.3.1.1", "JN.1", "XFG")
 )

```

#Plot all sequences volume by day (should be the same)
```{r}
#tot n sequences per day

cladetotn_usa <- cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "clade")

pangototn_usa <- pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "pango")


ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = cladetotn_usa %>% filter(variant == "clade"),
           aes(x = date, y = totn, fill = variant), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = pangototn_usa %>% filter(variant == "pango"),
            aes(x = date, y = totn, color = variant), size = .1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("clade" = "coral")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pango" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Sequences Over Time in USA",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Sequences",
    subtitle = "same number of sequences between clades and PANGOs"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
#proportions of each clade and pango lineage by day 
pangoprops_usa <- left_join(pangototn_usa, pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>% 
 mutate(pangoprop = sequences/totn) 

cladeprops_usa <- left_join(cladetotn_usa, cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>%  
mutate(cladeprop = sequences/totn) 


#make vectors of the clades inside the PANGO lineages based on the Nextstrain metadata 
pinc_21K <- (metadata_clade_pango %>% filter(clade_membership == "21K")) %>% 
  pull(pango_lineage)

pinc_21K <- (metadata_clade_pango %>% filter(clade_membership == "21K")) %>% 
  pull(pango_lineage)


#plot the clades next to the 

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = cladeprops_usa %>% filter(name == "21K"),
    aes(x = date, y = cladeprop),
    color = "black", size = 1.2
  ) + 
  geom_line(
    data = pangoprops_usa %>% 
      filter(name %in% (
        metadata_clade_pango %>% 
          filter(clade_membership == "21K") %>% 
          pull(pango_lineage)
      )),
    aes(x = date, y = pangoprop, color = name, group = name)
  )


pangoprops_usa %>% 
  filter(name %in% (metadata_clade_pango 
                    %>% filter(clade_membership == "21K") %>% 
                                       pull(pango_lineage)))



metadata_clade_pango %>% filter(clade_membership == "21K") %>% 
                                       pull(pango_lineage)
```
